div.div:
Public (public entrypoint): auth, docuseal, memos, privatebin, translate, hedgedoc, pdf, secret, plex, seerr.
Everything else is LAN-only (lan entrypoint, own app login, no Authentik).
Services outside the cluster (LXCs, Unraid) are reached through argo-apps external-services endpoints.
TLS: one wildcard certificate *.example.com (cert-manager, Cloudflare DNS-01).
